repair_runtime.scope: Later credential-free native FT2 preparation and bounded original-task smoke; baseline sections below retain their original timestamp.
repair_runtime.specific_snapshot_restore_failures: Provider reported Restore incomplete, 4/9 image files missing; all affected VMs confirmed archived.
repair_runtime.verified_alternative: Fresh VM, exact SHA256 Docker-save bundle, exact image-ID verification, native FT2, binary paused export and command deadline passed.

scope: Feasibility exploration only; one credential-free VM command smoke. No model campaigns or image builds launched.

capability_smoke.benchmark_container_smoke: not run; no suitable preinstalled image

historical_timing.scope: Historical attempt profiles, including repeats; not a Boat benchmark and not a guaranteed per-model speedup.

recommendation.layout: Trusted controller hosts upstream mini-swe-agent and provider model calls. One model-controlled offline Docker container per credential-free small Boat VM; bounded artifact collection back to controller. Keep canonical render/video local initially; bound that queue separately.
recommendation.provider_limits: Start with at most one active attempt per approved auth route; increase only after observing rate/quota behavior. Devin remains paused until renewal.
recommendation.no_speedup_claim: 94.6% median historical wall-time fraction was model requests. Parallelism targets campaign throughput, not individual model latency. No Boat campaign makespan measured.
recommendation.warm_template: Prepare compatible pinned x86_64 images in a trusted credential-free template, stop/snapshot, fork workers with --no-env and explicit TTL. Clear per-attempt state and never fork a dirty agent workspace.
recommendation.lifecycle: TTL longer than each frozen attempt budget plus export/cleanup margin; stop explicitly on every exit path. The 300s TTL was only for the capability probe.
recommendation.integration_required: Existing Docker/local-loopback lifecycle is not a drop-in remote runner. Review remote command timeouts, freeze/export, binary streams, image identity, FT2 ENTRYPOINT compatibility, and cleanup. Native upstream model migration is still pending.
recommendation.architecture: Host is ARM64; observed Boat is x86_64. Build compatible images and record separate execution provenance. Do not claim cross-architecture PCM bit equivalence.

restrictions: No Cursor agent wrapper or xAI Composer substitute
No provider or Boat credentials in untrusted containers
Do not expose loopback inference proxy publicly
Maintain network-none, non-root, read-only root, cap-drop, no-new-privileges and bounded resources
security_note: Remote scoring must get an explicitly clean environment and artifacts only; do not copy the host scorer ambient environment to Boat.
